en: The image shows a sepia-toned photograph of a large public square surrounded by historical buildings, with a notable domed church and a tall clock tower. There is a prominent fountain in the center of the square, and several people dressed in early 20th-century or late 19th-century European attire are walking or standing around. The text 'TRENTO' and 'Piazza del Duomo' is printed at the top.
